crossRefs.note: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
“How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
“Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
“Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

people.name: Job
people.line: A righteous man who endured great suffering

translations.web: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
translations.bsb: Pay attention, Job, and listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.
translations.kjv: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
translations.asv: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will speak.
